worldcombat.skill.mountaingale.summary: Tears a mountain-sized chunk of ice out and hurls it in a low arc: a direct hit takes the heaviest single blow in the family, the shatter catches everyone else in a ring, and the impact leaves ice with a cluster of spikes at its centre. It flies slowly and visibly, easy to dodge sideways - and has the longest wind-up.
worldcombat.skill.mountaingale.descripti: A direct hit deals about %1$s damage; the boulder's in-flight collision radius is %2$s blocks. The target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
It throws up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick with a fall coefficient of %3$s blocks per tick squared; heavier ice flies slower and is easier to dodge.
On landing, enemies within %1$s blocks each take splash damage; a direct hit also hurls its target %2$s blocks, at about %3$s splash power.
A direct hit has a %1$s flinch chance for %2$s s.
The ice and spikes left at the landing stay %1$s s, with central spikes %2$s blocks tall; the original blocks come back afterwards.
worldcombat.skill.mountaingale.glacier.o: Glacier form: a bigger, heavier boulder on a higher arc with taller spikes, but it flies slower with a longer wind-up and cooldown.
Shard form: a flatter, faster throw with a smaller radius and a quicker cast, at slightly less power and knockback.
worldcombat.skill.mountaingale.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %5$s PP, cooldown %4$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.mountaingale.growth.0: From level %1$s the boulder's damage rises to %2$s and the splash to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.mountaingale.growth.1: From level %1$s the boulder's damage rises to %2$s, the splash to %3$s, the shatter radius to %4$s blocks and the central spikes to %5$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.mountaingale.use.0: Land the heaviest single hit in the family from long range
worldcombat.skill.mountaingale.use.1: Catch a cluster at the landing with the bursting shards
worldcombat.skill.mountaingale.use.2: Raise a short line of ice spikes at the landing as cover
worldcombat.skill.mountaingale.preferenc: On: a bigger, heavier boulder on a higher arc with taller spikes, but slower in flight and with a longer wind-up and cooldown. Off: shard form, a flatter, faster throw with a smaller radius and a quicker cast.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens from farther, but the longer flight makes the landing easier to step out of.
Fresh only: skip a target another move already flinched, saving this for one that can still be staggered. Always: treat it as an ordinary attack.
